places.name: Sanssouci Palace (Potsdam)
places.ai_summary: A stunning Rococo palace surrounded by beautifully landscaped gardens, once the summer residence of Frederick the Great.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour to learn about the history of the palace.

places.name: Cecilienhof Palace
places.ai_summary: A historic palace known for hosting the Potsdam Conference at the end of World War II.

opening_hours.notes: Check for temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding gardens for a peaceful walk.

places.name: Brandenburg Gate (Potsdam)
places.ai_summary: A historic city gate in Potsdam, often overshadowed by its Berlin counterpart but equally impressive.

opening_hours.notes: Illuminated at night for a beautiful view.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a stroll through the nearby streets.

places.name: Biosphere Potsdam
places.ai_summary: A unique indoor tropical rainforest with a variety of plant species, animals, and a large waterfall.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't forget to visit the butterfly house inside.

places.name: Filmpark Babelsberg
places.ai_summary: A film studio and theme park where you can explore movie sets, watch stunt shows, and learn about film production.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays, check for seasonal opening times.

places.place_tip: Watch a live stunt show for an adrenaline-pumping experience.

places.name: Pfingstberg Belvedere
places.ai_summary: A historic lookout tower offering panoramic views of Potsdam and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Closed in winter months, check for exact dates.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a better view from the top.

places.name: Potsdam City Palace
places.ai_summary: The former royal palace in the city center, now housing a museum and the Brandenburg state parliament.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum to learn about the history of the palace and Brandenburg.

places.name: St. Nicholas Church
places.ai_summary: A beautiful baroque church in the city center of Potsdam, known for its impressive dome and interior.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Climb the dome for a great view of Potsdam.
places.address: St. Nicholas Church, Breite Str. 4, 14467 Potsdam, Germany

places.name: Brandenburg an der Havel Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A stunning example of brick Gothic architecture, this cathedral is a must-visit for history and architecture buffs.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to climb the tower for a panoramic view.

places.name: Spreewald Biosphere Reserve
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO biosphere reserve known for its unique swamp landscape, traditional wooden houses, and extensive network of canals.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by canoe or kayak.

places.place_tip: Try the local specialty, Spreewald gherkins, in one of the villages.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful palace located by the Rheinsberg Lake, known for its picturesque gardens and historic significance.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Take a walk around the lake for a scenic view of the palace.

places.place_tip: Visit the local shops for handmade cherry jam.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and architecture.

places.place_tip: Visit the observatory tower for a panoramic view of the park.

places.ai_summary: A picturesque lake district with clear waters and sandy beaches, ideal for swimming, sailing, and relaxing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy a day by the lake.

places.name: Cottbus Branitz Park
places.ai_summary: A beautiful park in Cottbus, featuring the famous Branitz Pyramid and a picturesque landscape.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in spring and summer.

places.place_tip: Visit the Branitz Pyramid, an iconic landmark of the park.

places.name: Wittenberge Elbe Promenade
places.ai_summary: A scenic promenade along the Elbe River in Wittenberge, perfect for a leisurely walk or bike ride.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in spring and summer.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat tour on the Elbe River for a different perspective.

places.name: Finow Canal
places.ai_summary: An important historical waterway in Brandenburg, ideal for boating and fishing.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by boat.

places.place_tip: Visit the Eberswalde Finow Canal Museum to learn about the canal's history.

places.name: Templin Spa Town
places.ai_summary: A charming spa town with historic architecture and beautiful lakes, perfect for relaxation and wellness.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a spa treatment in one of the local wellness centers.

attribution.title: Flag of Sweden
attribution.author: Jon Harald Søby and others.
attribution.credit:
This flag is regulated by Swedish Law, Act 1970:498, which states that "in commercial activities, the coats of arms, the flag or other official insignia of Sweden may not be used in a trademark or other insignia for products or services without proper authorization. This includes any mark or text referring to the Swedish government which thus can give the commercial mark a sign of official endorsement. This includes municipal coats of arms which are registered."
Colors regulated by Ordinance (1983:826), which specifies the exact shades and their properties

places.name: Lehnitzsee Lake
places.ai_summary: A scenic lake in Brandenburg, popular for swimming, sailing, and picnicking.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in summer.

places.place_tip: Bring your own boat or rent one locally to explore the lake.
